title: Fury as Indonesia declares late authoritarian ruler Suharto a national hero
summary: Suharto presided over a period marked by rampant corruption, nepotism, censorship and allegations of mass human rights abuses Indonesia has awarded former authoritarian leader Suharto the title of national hero, in a move that has sparked accusations of historical revisionism in the world’s third-largest democracy. The award has deepened fears about attempts to whitewash Suharto’s rise and decades-long rule , a period marked by rampant corruption, censorship and accusations of mass human rights violations. title: Norris wins Brazil GP to extend F1 championship lead over Piastri
summary: Lando Norris increased his championship points lead over McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri with three races remaining.
